# Raise OS

> Raise OS is a 5-phase fundraising system for pre-seed and seed founders that turns pitch decks into term sheets. 70+ founders, $120M+ raised, 200+ decks reviewed.

## What Raise OS is

Raise OS (https://www.raiseos.site/) is a pitch deck consulting and fundraising advisory run by founder Mouad Dliaa. It replaces spray-and-pray fundraising (bloated deck, 500 cold emails, undecodable polite passes) with five ordered phases. Every phase has a tool, a metric, and a playbook.

The five phases:

1. **Readiness** — Score your deck before investors do. The free Deck Rater grades a deck 0–100 across problem, solution, market, traction, team, and the ask, then lists the exact fixes.
2. **Aim** — Target 50 thesis-fit investors for your sector, stage, and geography. Volume is not a strategy.
3. **Ignite** — Sequenced outreach and warm-intro orchestration that converts to partner meetings.
4. **Sell** — Objection handling for the 20 questions partners actually ask ("Why won't Google build this?", "Why now?", "What's the moat?").
5. **Execute** — Weekly investor updates and FOMO sprints that compound momentum until the round closes oversubscribed.

## Who it is for

Pre-seed, Seed, and Series A founders raising £250k–£5M, primarily in B2B SaaS, AI infrastructure, FinTech, and HealthTech. Global.

## Proof

- 200+ pitch decks reviewed
- $120M+ raised by founders using the system
- 70+ founders worked with directly
- 94% of founders secure 2x+ more investor follow-up meetings after a rebuild (post-rebuild founder surveys)
- Case study: NovaHealth (HealthTech) — £1.4M seed closed in 19 days from first meeting; call #2 rate went from 4% to 45% after the rebuild. Founder: Marcus Vance.

## Services and pricing

- **Deck Audit — £250** (48-hour delivery): 90-second partner-lens Loom teardown, 30-min live audit call, slide scorecard.
- **Deck Rebuild Sprint — £1,500** (14 days): full narrative and slide rewrite, visual redesign, pitch script and FAQ, unlimited revisions.
- **1:1 Capital Raise Advisory — £3,500** (30 days): everything in the rebuild plus a 50+ investor target list, financial model review, and warm-intro orchestration.
- **Free**: Deck Rater (full report, no paywall) at https://www.raiseos.site/deck-rating.html; Pre-Seed Investor Search (100 verified funds, filter by region) at https://www.raiseos.site/investors.html; weekly Raise OS briefing on Substack (@raiseos).
- Risk reversal: if the initial audit call doesn't reveal at least 3 actionable narrative leaks costing you checks, you pay nothing.
